name: Die Herren - Farvelkoncert
description:
Die Herren ønsker at stoppe, mens de stadig kan levere ”den bedste koncert nogensinde” og derfor er tiden nu kommet til at sige farvel.
Det kalder selvfølgelig på et allersidste brag af en koncert i Kulturhuset Islands Brygge, hvor bandet kan tage afsked med alle de trofaste fans og følgere, der gennem årtier har været en del af deres U2-verden.

"Vi har haft en utrolig rejse, og det har været en ære at bringe U2's musik til live for så mange mennesker og helt utroligt, at vi har fået lov til det i så mange år. Vi ønsker også at vise den store taknemlighed, vi har for den danske live-scene. Vi har altid følt os værdsat og accepteret. Spillesteder, arrangører, bookere, teknikere, musikklubber, festivaler – alle har vist os respekt og givet os en seriøs behandling.  Tak for den tid I har givet os.
Vi gør klar til en sidste gang at stå ansigt til ansigt med det publikum, som vi altid har haft den største respekt for. Det skal blive en heftig afslutning på en fantastisk karriere, hvor vi en sidste gang skal give U2s fantastiske sange en værdig rock-tur igennem Die Herren-møllen.
Vi skal vise hvor gode de sange faktisk er – hvis I skulle være i tvivl!"

Praktisk info
Lørdag den 28. marts 2026 kl. 20 / Dørene åbner kl. 19.30
Entré: 295 kr. + gebyr / 350 kr. i døren
Koncerten er med ståpladser

name: Seamus Fogarty + Samantha Whates & Ida Wenøe
description:
Seamus Fogarty

Seamus Fogarty grew up on the west coast of Ireland but has lived in London since 2011.

With each release, Fogarty has refined his own unique style, characterised by a distinctive, moving and exploratory approach to music. Fragmented electronic sounds collide with melodic fragments, drones and field recordings. His songs challenge the fundamental elements of traditional styles such as folk, blues and country. Fogarty is far more interested in twisting and turning the music into something completely different – a world of soft motoric bass lines, twanging banjos and floating, rushing strings.

Fogarty has toured extensively in the UK, Ireland and Europe and has performed at many prominent festivals, including Green Man, Eurosonic, Latitude, Electric Picnic, Mosely Folk and Haldern Pop.

The Guardian gives Fogarty 5 stars, writing: “Magical journeys through fable and modern life and back again, often in the same song”.

Samantha Whates

Samantha Whates is a highly respected artist on the British folk and roots scene. Her beautiful and poetic songs capture both the pain and beauty of human life, and she has maintained a strong connection to her Scottish roots.

Whates has developed her own unique fingerstyle technique, and her songs are structurally bold. Her pure and clear voice meets raw field recordings and is spiced with unconventional backing vocals. Samantha's skills in backing vocals have taken her far and wide – on worldwide tours with Noel Gallagher, to praise from Dolly Parton and now in almost symbiotic recordings and live collaborations with Ida Wenøe.

Ida Wenøe

Ida Wenøe has created her own musical style by blending foreign influences such as Nick Drake, Joni Mitchell and Beth Gibbons with her roots, which range from traditional folk music and the Højskolesangbogen songbook to inspiration from English folk music.

She has played hundreds of concerts across Europe and North America and has built a reputation as an intense and powerful live performer.

Ida Wenøe works with dense storytelling, often using nature as inspiration. Her voice has both nerve and strength, drawing on folk traditions from the 60s and 70s, yet always giving the music her own unique touch. The accompaniment is characterised by subtle but insistent guitar playing, flanked by violin, double bass and flutes, and not least floating vocal harmonies.

In 2021, she won a Danish Music Award as ‘Danish Roots Artist of the Year’ and Clash Magazine describes her as ‘Bewitching acid folk with a deeply personal edge.’

name: THE MON [IT] KARITI [IT] (PSYCH/DARK FOLK)
description:
One of the first announcements for 2026 is the weird and wonderful THE MON and KARITI!!! Setting the stage for a fantastic year of announcements and events! Press on dear reader/listening/traveller for more details!

THE MON is the solo project of Urlo, vocalist and bassist of the long-running Italian heavy-psychedelic trio Ufomammut, co-founder of the internationally renowned poster art collective Malleus Rock Art Lab, and of the independent label Supernatural Cat. 

Where Ufomammut projects massive, otherworldly soundscapes, THE MON offers a more vulnerable and introspective experience. The music moves through shadowy electronic landscapes, ambient textures, and hypnotic dark folk, always guided by an emotional core that searches for meaning, balance, and transformation. 

The name THE MON evokes several layers of meaning: a contraction of “demon,” “monk,” and the Japanese word 門 (mon, meaning “gate”), a symbolic passage toward altered states of consciousness and inner truth. This duality of light and dark, sacred and profane, runs through the entire project. 

Joining forces on this tour are co-conspirators KARITI (карити)-‘to mourn the dead ‘in church Slavonic-is an emotional & creative outlet of ekaterina-a Russian-born poet and song writer based in Italy.Her debut ‘Covered Mirrors’ was released in 2020(Aural music) and represents a ‘cathartic peregrination through bereavement’. The sophomore record ‘Dheghom’ (Lay Bare recordings, saw a development in sound, songwriting and instrumentation played by ekaterina, adding key instruments to her previously main tool-guitar. Dheghom also features a few contributions by guest musicians and a haunting duet with Dorthia Cottrell(Windhand). Marco, the leader of the heavy sludge band Grime contributes to some of the songs with additional guitars/drones/noise and often joins KARITI for live performances.

name: Gunni Torp + Carsten Lykke med band + Nattog
description:
Gunni Torp åbner aftenen med moderne viser og folkpop med kant. Med sin harmonika, sit nærvær og sine dansksprogede sange formår hun at fange publikum med tekster, der balancerer det politiske, det poetiske og det humoristiske. Hun har udgivet fem album og er senest aktuel med SPRINGBALSAMIN fra 2025. Hendes koncerter rummer både det skæve, det festlige og det eftertænksomme, altid med et stærkt personligt udtryk.

Carsten Lykke kan denne aften opleves sammen med sit band. For første gang siden udgivelsen af soloalbummet Selvoptaget fra 2001 spiller trioen bandversioner af sangene fra albummet, side om side med udvalgte numre fra ibens’ bagkatalog og sange fra Lykkes nyere soloarbejde. Mellem numrene deler han anekdoter fra et liv med op- og nedture, fortalt med selvironi, underspillet humor og musikalsk overskud. Publikum kan forvente en koncert med både grin, genkendelse og stærke melodier.

Nattog afrunder aftenen med støjende poprock og et dansksproget tekstunivers, der kredser om hverdagens trivialiteter og den langsomme bevægelse mod noget endnu ukendt. Musikken bevæger sig mellem det drømmende og det larmende, det håbefulde og det fortvivlende, båret af pulserende trommer, melodisk bas og stemningsfulde guitarflader.

Klub Geyser er en tilbagevendende sangskriver-showcase i Kulturhuset Islands Brygge med flere årlige koncerter, hvor både nye og mere erfarne solister og bands præsenterer kortere sæt. Aftenen bindes sammen af optrædende vært, Jacob Speake.

name: Depeche Mode – lyden af håb
description:
Få indblik i synth-pop-ikonernes udvikling 1981-1993.

Vi dykker ned i Depeche Modes maskinrum! Fra deres første lp "Speak and Spell" og op gennem 1980’erne, hvor deres univers ændrer sig markant med den teknologiske udvikling.

Depeche Mode tager en række tigerspring i årene 1981-1993; fra "en-finger-analoge-synthesizere" til digitale synthesizere, sampling og brug af såkaldt almindelige instrumenter, som vi i foredraget vil se eksempler på gennem lyd, billede og video. 

Vi skal også høre om sangskriver Martin Gores tanker om håb, lys og mørke gennem sangene, som oftest er i dur.

Stefan Teilmann Laub Nielsen tager os med på rejsen gennem musikhistorien og deler ud af sin store viden om Depeche Mode.

Stefan Teilmann Laub Nielsen er komponist, musiker, forfatter, lærer, lektor og har en cand.mag. i musikvidenskab.

Stefan Teilmann arbejder desuden med korprojektet Elektrokor med KOREt, hvor Depeche Modes numre fortolkes flerstemmigt i akustiske og elektroniske udgaver, samt med Depeche Mode-coverbandet USELESS.

name: Tech Talk – sociale robotter
description:
Tech Talk – sociale robotter
Robotterne kommer – men gør det noget? Få en fyraftensøl, mens Morten Roed Frederiksen fra IT-Universitetet gør os klogere på, hvordan robotter kan afhjælpe angst.
Med den gamle skrækfortælling "Robotterne kommer!" er det ikke underligt, at vi mennesker kan blive lidt teknologi-angste. Men måske kan fremtidens robotter rent faktisk hjælpe med angsten.

Sociale robotter på plejehjem har øget trivslen for ældre, men området rummer potentiale for meget mere.   

Med udgangspunkt i robotteknologi, interaktionsdesign og menneskelig psykologi vil Morten Roed Frederiksen fra IT Universitetet fortælle om, hvordan teknologi kan engagere, støtte og berolige på måder, der opleves naturlige og meningsfulde. 

Undervejs kan du nyde en fyraftensøl eller -vand. Medlemmer af Biblioteksklubben får den første kvit og frit. Meld dig ind her.

Hvem er Morten Roed Frederiksen?
Morten Roed Frederiksen er med til at forme den næste generation af sociale robotter, som skal gøre en reel forskel for både børn, familier og behandlere. Han har arbejdet med at gøre teknologien mere levende, nærværende og tryghedsskabende og dermed styrke kommunikationen mellem mennesker og maskiner. 

På baggrund af dette arbejder han med at udvikle robotter, der kan hjælpe børn med angst.

name: Madame Machine
description:
Madame Machine er en jazz-manouche- og swingkvintet, grundlagt i København i 2022. Gruppen er viet til den tidløse ånd af Django Reinhardt og bringer den levende energi fra Hot Jazz-æraen ind i nutiden.
I deres selskab oplever du en fejring af det ikoniske partnerskab mellem Django Reinhardt og violinisten Stéphane Grappelli – og de rige samarbejder med træblæserlegender som Coleman Hawkins og Hubert Rostaing.
Med respekt for traditionen og en moderne kreativitet leverer Madame Machine friske arrangementer af Djangos klassiske kompositioner. Samtidig præsenterer de originale værker, der føles både hippe og dybt rodfæstede i jazz manouche-æstetikken.
Deres lyd afspejler den drivkraft og spontanitet, som er selve hjertet af Djangos arv – en musikalsk oplevelse, der både hylder fortiden og begejstrer i nuet.

Madame Machine is a jazz manouche and swing quintet devoted to the timeless spirit of Django Reinhardt and the vibrant energy of the hot jazz era. Founded in Copenhagen in 2022, the group celebrates not only the well-known partnership between Django and violinist Stéphane Grappelli, but also his rich collaborations with horn and woodwind greats such as Coleman Hawkins and Hubert Rostaing.

Blending respect for tradition with modern creativity, Madame Machine brings fresh arrangements to Django’s classic compositions.
They also craft original works that feel both hip and rooted in the manouche aesthetic.
The group’s sound reflects the drive and spontaneity at the heart of Django’s legacy.

Line-up:
Jason shooster - guitar
Mikkel Hermansen- guitar
Ali badreldin - saxes 
Andrea Crespi - Clarinet
Thorbjørn Kaas - Bas

name: KLEIS solo exhibition: Wakin ^  the Dormice
description:
As spring starts and the flowers bloom, 
the dormice wake up! 
It’s now time to be aware! 
Topor nomore! 
Realize your emotions and the chaos within! 
Wake up and smell the roses!
-KLEIS

As the rhythms of spring unfold and the natural world reawakens, The Dormice Awake invites audiences to confront the inner landscapes that stir beneath the surface of everyday perception. In this body of work, KLEIS channels the season’s energy as a metaphor for emotional and psychological emergence, prompting a heightened awareness of both subtle and turbulent states of being.

Drawing from motifs of renewal and introspection, the exhibition navigates between chaos and clarity, urging an embodied recognition of our emotional registers. KLEIS frames this moment of transition not as serene awakening but as an urgent invitation to “wake up” to the proliferating forces within and around us.

FREE EVENT 

Opening on March 28th at 16
exhibition on view until April 26th, 2026

__________

Red Door Gallery and Magazine is an independent, artist-run cultural platform based in Copenhagen, operating at Møllegade 23a in the Nørrebro district. It functions both as a physical exhibition space and as the base for Red Door Magazine, a quarterly arts and culture publication with an international network of correspondents and contributors. The initiative was founded to support freedom of expression and to foster interdisciplinary exchange among artists, writers, poets and cultural organisers without paywalls or restrictive access. The gallery’s programme includes exhibitions, workshops, performances, talks, publications and events that foreground experimental, hybrid and community-centred practices, with a focus on poetry, translation, print culture and visual art. Red Door also hosts the Red Transmissions podcast and the Poetic Phonotheque, expanding its engagement beyond the exhibition walls through digital and audio formats. Its activities reflect a commitment to accessibility, independent voices and cross-disciplinary dialogue in both local and global contexts.

description:
The New Song Circle is your monthly songwriters' new song workshop. Last Sunday of the month. It's free and no registration needed.

name: Off The Cuff: An Improv Comedy Show
description:
Join us for a night of English-language improv comedy where everything is made up on the spot! Expect quick wit, wild characters, and hilarious stories you'll never see again.

Every scene, every character, every twist is inspired by audience suggestions. From absurd situations to razor-sharp wordplay, anything can (and will) happen!

Whether you're an improv regular or totally new to it, this show promises a fast-paced, feel-good evening full of surprises.

What to expect:

Four unique improv troupes performing back-to-back
English-language comedy — accessible for everyone
Completely unscripted, totally one-of-a-kind show
A fun, friendly atmosphere and lots of laughter

name: Semphiz & Telepa-T
description:
In December 2025, they released yet another chapter in their long-standing collaboration with the album Vendetta.
The Copenhagen-based rapper Semphiz, formerly known as Semih Automatisk, has been making waves in the Danish underground rap scene for more than a decade. He first emerged with the rap collective B.O.C and later with the group Sigma, with whom he released two albums throughout the 2010s.

Semphiz’s expression is authentic and explosive, keeping the listener on edge with his inventive language and vivid portraits. Telepa-T’s melodic and cinematic productions complete the storytelling, taking the audience on a high-speed journey filled with intensity and suspense.

Experience an intense rap show driven by powerful storytelling and uncompromising energy. This is not background music. It’s raw rap, heavy beats, and stories that hit hard – live and unfiltered.
